lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrTmO₃ (Sr₄Tm₄O₁₂ per cell) crystallizes in monoclinic symmetry with space group C2/c (No. 15) and contains 20 atoms across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Tm centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Sr centers have nine O neighbors; O centers are surrounded by two Tm neighbors. The same analysis identifies corner-sharing between Tm octahedra and edge-sharing between Sr and Tm polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic neighbor graph.
